question: Unsa ang mga notice ug proseso nga ipatuman sa Business Bureau sa dili pa ipasira ang usa ka negosyo nga dunay kalapasan?
answer:
Sa Business Bureau, kung wala pa ipasira ang isang negosyo, mao ang mga notice ug proseso na ipatuman:

1. [S3] Business Bureau CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II.pdf | printed page 120 | chunk DEV120-BB-PDF0081-C001
   - 3. Wait for scheduled inspection
   - 3.1 Route the complaint / request for inspection
   - 3.2 Assign the complaint/request to the Inspection Team
   - 4. Receive Inspection Report/ 1st Notice of Violation/ICAB Accreditation
   - 4. Conduct Ocular Inspection and issue Inspection Report as proof of inspection (no violation) or 1st Notice (with violation) and ICAB Accreditation with Order of Payment for Accreditation if compliant

Wala pa nga kini ang mga detalye sa proseso sa mga notice ug mga deadlines, kay wala pa nga nakit-an sa Citizens' Charter ang mga detalye sa mga ito. ([S3])

ground_truth: Non-compliant businesses receive a 1st Notice of Violation with an inspection report. If uncorrected after re-inspection within 15 days, a 2nd and Final Notice with Cease-and-Desist Order is recommended. Continued non-compliance results in a physical Closure Order within 1 day.
